title: add-env-var-override-for-default-span-export
request: Can we make is_default_export_span export everything when LANGFUSE_EXPORT_ALL env var is truthy? Right now it always filters, I'd like a way to force all spans through for debugging.
reference_diff:
--- a/langfuse/_client/span_filter.py
+++ b/langfuse/_client/span_filter.py
@@ -102,7 +102,16 @@
 
 
 def is_default_export_span(span: ReadableSpan) -> bool:
-    """Return whether a span should be exported by default."""
+    """Return whether a span should be exported by default.
+
+    If the ``LANGFUSE_EXPORT_ALL`` environment variable is set to a truthy value
+    ("1", "true", or "yes" case‑insensitive), all spans are exported
+    regardless of other filters. This is useful for debugging when you want to
+    see every span generated by the SDK.
+    """
+    import os
+    if os.getenv("LANGFUSE_EXPORT_ALL", "").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}:
+        return True
     return (
         is_langfuse_span(span) or is_genai_span(span) or is_known_llm_instrumentor(span)
     )
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_span_filter_env.py
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import os
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+import pytest
+
+from langfuse.span_filter import is_default_export_span
+
+
+def _make_span(*, scope_name=None, attributes=None):
+    scope = None if scope_name is None else SimpleNamespace(name=scope_name)
+    return SimpleNamespace(instrumentation_scope=scope, attributes=attributes)
+
+
+def test_is_default_export_span_respects_env_var(monkeypatch):
+    # Span that would normally be filtered out
+    span = _make_span(scope_name="unknown.scope", attributes={})
+    # Default behavior: not exported
+    assert is_default_export_span(span) is False
+
+    # Enable export of all spans via env var
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LANGFUSE_EXPORT_ALL", "true")
+    assert is_default_export_span(span) is True
+
+    # Explicitly disable via a falsy value should revert to normal logic
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LANGFUSE_EXPORT_ALL", "false")
+    assert is_default_export_span(span) is False
